data_integrity_note: The task's stated inputs for Gap Fade (t=5.12 5-day IC from a '573-name, 2020-2026 intraday library', plus a claimed non-earnings +18.7%/yr vs earnings -23.4%/yr split) could not be verified against anything in this codebase.
